0.0: This will be a long story. *Ahem.*
0.1: That vile #rMagnus#k invaded and took over #bHeliseum#k, our capital. We're using our temple, #b#m400000000##k, as our base until we can take the city back.
0.2: When we had enough strength, we established #b#m401000000##k and took our first steps to take back the capital.
0.3: Sadly, #rMagnus#k's forces were stronger than we realized. Now even our base is in danger. That's why we're asking outsiders like you for help.
0.4: At least #b#m400000000##k is an easy spot to defend. The problem is holding #b#m401000000##k, where fighting is breaking out.
0.6: #b#p3001000##k and #b#p3001001##k are in charge there. We're counting on you, my Maple Warrior friend.

yes.0: The portal to #bHeliseum#k is just up the stairs to the right. The scout, #b#p3001007##k, will take you to our commanders.

no.0: You won't even shed a little blood for our sakes? How rude!

1.0: You must be a Maple Warrior!\r\n#L0##bYes. You look like you're in trouble.#l\n#k
1.1: Yes. We're barely holding the Heliseum Reclamation HQ, but the Specters launched an aerial strike. I really, really don't like aerial strikes!\r\n#L0##bGive me the details.#l\n#k
1.2: Sure! Aerial strikes are terrible because... Or did you mean about the tactical situation?
